passage.text: Nam, Ploy's birthday is next Friday!
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈplɔɪz ˈbɜːrθdeɪ ɪz ˈnɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ!

passage.text: Let's have a surprise party for her at my place.
passage.reading: ˈlɛts ˈhæv ə sərˈpraɪz ˈpɑːrti fər hɜːr ət maɪ ˈpleɪs.

passage.text: It's a secret, so don't tell her!
passage.reading: ɪts ə ˈsiːkrət, soʊ ˈdoʊnt ˈtɛl hɜːr!

passage.text: Great idea, Emma! I'll buy a cake and some balloons.
passage.reading: ˈɡreɪt aɪˈdiːə, ˈɛmə! aɪl ˈbaɪ ə ˈkeɪk ənd sʌm bəˈluːnz.

passage.text: How about inviting our friends from class, too?
passage.reading: ˈhaʊ əˈbaʊt ɪnˈvaɪtɪŋ aʊr ˈfrɛndz frəm ˈklæs, ˈtuː?

passage.text: Ploy loves karaoke, so we can sing together.
passage.reading: ˈplɔɪ ˈlʌvz ˌkɛriˈoʊki, soʊ wiː kən ˈsɪŋ təˈɡɛðər.

passage.text: Sounds good! Let's meet at my place at six.
passage.reading: ˌsaʊndz ˈɡʊd! ˈlɛts ˈmiːt ət maɪ ˈpleɪs ət ˈsɪks.

passage.text: Ploy is coming at seven, so we have an hour to decorate.
passage.reading: ˈplɔɪ ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ ət ˈsɛvən, soʊ wiː ˈhæv ən ˈaʊər tə ˈdɛkəreɪt.

passage.text: And don't forget: it's a secret!
passage.reading: ənd ˈdoʊnt fərˈɡɛt: ɪts ə ˈsiːkrət!
